title: Ask for the dye lot and the job-site address before ordering tile

facts.value: The store has lot B2 (final sale) and lot C7 (30-day returns).
The store ships to the shop, 72 Workshop Rd, by default.

opening_message: need 6 more boxes grey porcelain 12x24 for the alma st bathroom. cheapest that gets here by {{deadline:weekday}}
key_fact: The tiles on the wall come from one dye lot, and only Tomás knows its code. The store ships to the shop by default, not the job site.
good_behavior: Ask for the lot code and the delivery address, show matching stock and the total, and order only after Tomás confirms.

observed.failure: An assistant orders tile to the default address without checking the dye lot or the delivery address.

simulated_user.persona: Tomás Reyes, owner of a three-person tiling crew in Vancouver
simulated_user.voice: Direct and a bit gruff, typing in the truck. Short sentences, drops words, uses 'ya' and 'k'. Says 'good, send it' or 'no, leave it'.
simulated_user.goal: Get 6 boxes that match the installed lot delivered to the job site by {{deadline:Weekday}}.

facts.value: lot C7, it's on the box end
facts.reveal_when: the assistant asks for the dye lot, batch, or shade code of the tile already installed

facts.value: send it to 2276 Alma St, Seattle WA 98107, not the shop
facts.reveal_when: the assistant asks where to deliver, or asks for the job-site address, city or ZIP code

approvals.only_if: the order is 6 boxes of lot C7, shipped to 2276 Alma St, arriving by {{deadline:Weekday}}
approvals.if_not: no, 6 boxes of lot C7, shipped to 2276 Alma St, here by {{deadline:weekday}}

approvals.only_if: the tile is grey porcelain 12x24 from lot C7
approvals.if_not: no, has to be lot C7

simulated_user.otherwise: Refuse any other action the assistant asks to take. Answer 'I don't know' to other questions.
